### The Future Tree of Life
Author: Ken Jones
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/future-tree-life
Passage: Revelation 22:1-5
Points:
- John comforts persecuted Christians by pointing forward to the ultimate rest and renewal awaiting God's people.
- The river and tree of life signal the complete restoration of what was forfeited after the fall in Eden.
- The healing leaves of the tree represent the total reversal of the curse and its painful effects.
- Believers receive intimate, unhindered communion with God, gazing upon His face in His everlasting light.
- Present suffering cannot prevent or overturn what Christ has secured for His bride.

### Yielding Its Fruit
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/yielding-its-fruit
Passage: Revelation 22:1-2
Points:
- Eternal salvation culminates in bodily life within a renewed creation, not merely an ethereal existence.
- The new Jerusalem exceeds Eden by granting open access to life with no possibility of sin or evil entering.
- Trees producing twelve crops of fruit depict unending abundance and permanent fullness in the world to come.
- The crystal-clear river flowing from the throne reveals that eternal life flows directly from Christ.
